MESSAGE FROM DANA:
Suggest snacks with nuts or peanut butter I could keep at my desk.

response.text: Hi Dana! For desk-friendly snacks with nuts or peanut butter, try individual packets of peanut butter with whole-grain crackers, trail mix with almonds and peanuts, or single-serving nut butter cups. You could also keep a jar of roasted almonds or peanut butter-filled pretzels—just watch portion sizes. Let me know if you want more ideas!
